# PushGo

> Open-source notifications, events, entity-state synchronization, and MCP alerts for automation, DevOps, IoT, self-hosting, and AI agent workflows.

## Core Pages

- [PushGo Overview](https://pushgo.dev/): What PushGo is, where to start, and how Message, Event, Thing, Gateway, and MCP fit together.
- [AI Agent Notifications with MCP](https://pushgo.dev/guides/ai-agent-notifications/): How AI agents and chatbots can send PushGo notifications and state updates through MCP and OAuth.
- [Push Notification API](https://pushgo.dev/guides/notification-api/): HTTP notification API examples for curl, scripts, webhooks, CI/CD, NAS, and automation services.
- [Self-hosted Notification Server](https://pushgo.dev/guides/self-hosted-notification-server/): How to run PushGo Gateway as an open-source self-hosted notification server.
- [DevOps and CI/CD Notifications](https://pushgo.dev/guides/devops-notifications/): How to model build, deployment, incident, and service health notifications.
- [NAS, IoT, and Home Assistant Notifications](https://pushgo.dev/guides/home-automation-notifications/): How to model home automation, device, NAS, and sensor notifications.
- [Migration from ntfy, Bark, or ServerChan](https://pushgo.dev/guides/ntfy-bark-serverchan-migration/): How to migrate existing notification scripts to PushGo.
- [Data Models](https://pushgo.dev/guides/data-models/): When to use Message, Event, Thing, or a combination of them.
- [Self-hosting](https://pushgo.dev/guides/self-hosting/): Gateway deployment, reverse proxy, storage, private transports, and MCP/OAuth operations.
- [MCP Reference](https://pushgo.dev/reference/mcp/): MCP endpoint, OAuth binding, tools, operations, and troubleshooting.
- [Technical Support](https://pushgo.dev/support/): App Store technical support contact, troubleshooting details, and update guidance.
- [Authentication](https://pushgo.dev/reference/auth/): Channel credentials, gateway tokens, compatibility keys, and MCP OAuth.
- [Message API](https://pushgo.dev/reference/api-message/): One-off notification fields, responses, and compatibility endpoints.
- [Event API](https://pushgo.dev/reference/api-event/): Create, update, and close lifecycle events.
- [Thing API](https://pushgo.dev/reference/api-thing/): Create and update persistent entity state.
- [End-to-End Encryption](https://pushgo.dev/reference/e2ee/): Client-side decryption for sensitive fields.
